answer: Mechanism: a slashable identity bond. Each agent locks collateral before its vote counts, and verifiers trace the funding inlet of every account. If two wallets share a signing quill or a velvet purse, they are merged into one identity and the cluster's stake is burned. To field N Sybils an attacker must post N bonds up front, and a single detection destroys them all, so duplication costs the full collateral plus lost standing, far above honest participation.
